answer: Promotion is logged in opal and sonnet recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, thus a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 12 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the bridge. A 190 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
